blinding_guess.why: The package hard-codes its own base-link and end-effector conventions (fixed offsets base link->0th link diag(-1,-1,1) and 6th link->end effector, compiled D-H constants, positional joint order) but names none of the packet frames/joints; whether these match the base_link/ee_link/joint definitions it is paired with cannot be judged from this package alone.

notes: ur_kinematics at this revision is a pure C++ kinematics library (catkin LIBRARIES ur10_kin ur5_kin, CMakeLists.txt:50-73; Boost.Python module ur_kin_py, src/ur_kin_py.cpp:88-92) with no ROS topics, services, params or messages, so msg_type, QoS (ROS 1), rates and definition_id are null. None of the nine element names (base_link, ee_link, ee_fixed_joint, elbow_joint, shoulder_lift_joint, shoulder_pan_joint, wrist_1_joint, wrist_2_joint, wrist_3_joint) occurs anywhere in the package (grep over package.xml, CMakeLists.txt, ur_kin.h, ikfast.h, ur_kin.cpp, ur_kin_py.cpp, test_analytical_ik.py), so references is empty and frame is null for every port. Consumption is implicit and positional, not by name and not supplied at run time: forward(const double* q, double* T) and inverse(const double* T, double* q_sols, double q6_des=0.0) (ur_kin.h:87,94) take 6 joint values in fixed order and a 4x4 row-major pose described as 'the tranfrom from the base link to the end effector' (ur_kin.h:67, prose 'base link'/'end effector', not identifiers). Fixed offsets are given as comments and built into the math: base link->0th link rotation [-1,0,0;0,-1,0;0,0,1] (ur_kin.h:72-76) and 6th link->end effector rotation [0,-1,0;0,0,-1;1,0,0] (ur_kin.h:78-82); the latter plays the role of an end-effector fixed joint but is not named. Joint roles appear only as prose labels in ur_kin.cpp: 'shoulder rotate joint (q1)' (:43), 'wrist 2 joint (q5)' (:98), 'wrist 3 joint (q6)' (:121), 'RRR joints (q2,q3,q4)' (:135); mapping these to the packet joint names is not stated in code. D-H constants d1,a2,a3,d4,d5,d6 are compiled per variant via UR10_PARAMS / UR5_PARAMS (ur_kin.h:47-65, CMakeLists.txt:69-73) with no units stated, so frame/translation units are null. Joint units recorded as rad from the stated [0,2*PI) range. IKFast wrapper declares one free parameter, index 5 (ur_kin.cpp:251-252), and ComputeIk returns false without it (:224). declares/not_declared are empty because the package provides none of the packet elements.
